annotations.text:
ENTRY FLOW — dark grid-control-room direction.
Archivo + IBM Plex Sans/Mono, oklch accents on near-black.

Landing: filter the 34 capabilities by domain and persona, search them, click the proof chain, switch the pricing cycle.
Sign in: three auth methods, six roles, and a live preview of what each role's session can actually see.
Activation: three steps, manual entry or bill scan, real plan prices.

CONSUMER APP — everything here responds.
Live register ticks, the range toggle redraws the chart, top-ups move the prepaid ring, language switches the whole shell.
Bills: click any charge line to trace it back to the two register reads behind it.
Analytics: the filter rail is real — meters, read quality, direction, a minimum-kWh slider, saved views, sortable columns.

OPERATOR — denser, cyan-keyed, its own filter model.
Loss threshold slider, feeder and signal facets, three sort orders. Pick any transformer to drill into its consumers; the audit stream on the right is the append-only ledger.
